summary.text: Joe Tate is a Democratic member of the Michigan House of Representatives serving his fourth term for District 9, which covers Detroit's Downtown, Belle Isle and Eastside communities.
His caucus biography says he was Michigan's first Black Speaker of the House.

paragraphs.text: Tate's biography says he earned a scholarship to play football at Michigan State University and then played in the National Football League.
He later served in the U.S. Marine Corps and deployed twice to Afghanistan during Operation Enduring Freedom.
After his discharge he earned an MBA and a master's in environmental policy and planning from the University of Michigan.
Before joining the Legislature he was a program manager for the Detroit Economic Growth Corp., helping small businesses grow.
